original_test_intent: Repeatedly read/export the identified GPU FRU through the exact AGT I2C path for 24 hours and prove every response is complete, valid, correct and attributable without disturbing the management bus.
original_method: Pin AGT, read-only mode, GPU/BMC/I2C target and FRU schema/reference; perform a parseable pilot; loop exact source read with approved cadence and per-read timeout for a full 24-hour elapsed window, preserving unique raw output/hash/decoded fields each iteration, stopping on first mismatch/bus/health error, then verify BMC/I2C/GPU health and zero missing iterations.
manual_activity: GPU/BMC manufacturing owner approves exact read mode, target/schema/reference, 24-hour cadence/storage and bus recovery and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Expected FRU schema, size, checksums and field reference
24-hour cadence, timeout, iteration accounting and evidence capacity
Bus-health telemetry, maintenance approval and non-writing recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Prove mode is read-only and target before repetition
Rate-limit access and prevent overlapping reads or competing bus operation
Never overwrite or conflate iteration outputs
Stop on timeout, parse/checksum/field mismatch, bus/controller or GPU/log anomaly
Terminate cleanly; do not reset BMC, clear evidence or auto-retry failed reads
agent_execution_scope: Run exact bounded read loop after approval
Validate and account for every iteration independently
Stop-first-error, verify final health and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target/read semantics, FRU oracle and cadence
Interpret any intermittent or field/checksum change

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic `agt fru read` does not preserve tuple `4,100,1,9`, output behavior or target identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run verified exact `./agt -i2cflrm:4,100,1,9,<unique-iteration-output>` sequentially under per-read timeout for the approved full elapsed window; preserve exact argv/output per iteration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Tuple, fifteen-minute attendance and 1,440-minute elapsed window remain; cadence is an approved input, not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Journal start/end/sequence for each read, store immutable raw hash and decoded checksum/field verdict, and reconcile attempted/completed/passed/failed/missing counts against elapsed time.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines 'every time' with lossless accounting and full FRU validity rather than repeated console text.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One successful read or repeated cached/overwritten content cannot substitute for 24-hour fresh reads.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Stable identical FRU content is expected; freshness must come from process/timestamp/audit evidence, not artificial content changes.

project_override_considerations: Manufacturing owner defines safe I2C cadence, evidence retention/redaction and whether concurrent BMC accesses must be excluded.
expected_evidence: AGT hash/version, read-only proof and stable target/region map
Approved cadence/timeout/window plus start/end monotonic timing
Every iteration's sequence, exact argv, exit, duration, raw output hash/size
Every iteration's schema/checksum and expected-versus-observed field result
Pre/final BMC/I2C/GPU/OS logs, stop reason and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently specifies exact repeated FRU read for 24 hours and correct output each time.

blocked_analysis.analysis: AGT, map, schema and long-run policy are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Preserves exact read path while making every-iteration completeness, freshness, output retention and bus safety auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: A 24-hour loop can appear successful while overwriting one file, skipping timeouts or replaying cached output. Lossless sequence accounting and unique raw hashes prove each invocation produced a complete response. FRU values should remain stable, so freshness must be established by process timing and bus transaction evidence. Repeated management-bus access also needs rate control because a nominal read can starve other controllers.
